camps.description_short: A STEAM-focused day program for children entering grades 1-6, held at East School in Natick. Days run 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM and include hands-on science, technology, engineering, art and math projects, plus daily swim, sports and games.
camps.refund_policy_summary: A $50 per week, per child deposit is due at registration and is not refundable. Deposits can be moved to other camp programs before April 1 but not after.
